questions.learningObjective: Find perpendicular vector via negative reciprocal slope
questions.stem: A board vector (2,1) has a perpendicular vector (1,k) (dot product zero). What is k?
questions.explanation: Dot product = 2*1 + 1*k = 0, so k = -2. Using reciprocal gives 2.
questions.hint: Set the dot product to zero and solve.
